notes.title: VRosty
notes.content:

Also with the last update the hoVRpark got a big make-over:
[list]
[*] New vegetation, performance-optimized, beautiful autumn colors
[*] Better braking physics
[*] New Sounds
[*] More “Holograffities”
[*] Bugfixes
[/list]

Let me know how you like the changes and boarding on sand. Oh, and please tell me how “interplanetary travelling” or "VR-Planet Hopping" feels for you.

notes.title: A Mountain Of New Things
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=TQf2uT3dK_Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Level “hoVRpeak”[/h2]
You wanted snow? You'll get a whole mountain of it. But it's still not a snowboard game!

[h2]Adaptive Music[/h2]
The game finally has a soundtrack. And it's adaptive. The music changes between relaxed background music and action-loaded beat and guitars, depending on how relaxed or action-loaded you drive. Big thanks to Plush Rabbit Studios.

[h2]Better Braking[/h2]
The carving or crosswise positioning of the board to the direction you go now has a greater braking effect and makes the riding behaviour even more similar to that of a snowboard.

[h2]More challenges[/h2]
Currently we are at 62, and there are also infinite ways you can find your own.

[h2]Challenge Mode [/h2]
By popular demand, some challenges are a little easier by showing better where you have to go. Others are not.

[h2]Looping mode [/h2]
For the particularly daring among you I have adapted the (optional) looping mode. Please give feedback on how you find it.

notes.title: Controls Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
I do my best to fulfill your wishes...

[h1]Smooth Turning[/h1]
[list]
[*] requested by many, now on touchpad press / joystick
[*] Personally I prefer to turn my whole body. That´s the way I developed the game and trained my VR-legs :-) But I understand that some people don´t like it. 
[*] Please let me know if this works for you.
[/list]

[h1]Invert Thrust[/h1]
[list]
[*] Quick Fix: Press "i" on your keyboard during game, if you want to accelerate and boost with your front hand.
[*] I will add a menu solution later
[/list]

[h1]Looping Mode[/h1]
[list]
[*] Some very fearless users requested "upside down". So I experimented with this. My stomach does not like it. So all I can do is warn you:
[*] DON`T PRESS "L" during game! This will activate the looping mode.
[*] Then you can press Touchpad or Joystick up/down, when in air. 
[*] Please let me know, if you survived this :-)
[/list]

[h1]Spectator Camera[/h1]
[list]
[*] If you want to make a video, you might want to use a 3rd Person camera
[*] Press "c" in game
[*] Use the arrow keys to move the cam
[*] Use PgUp / PgDwn to zoom
[*] Show me your stunts! :-)
[/list]

Please let me know, if all of that works for you.
Tomy
